distributed_runtime_note: B1 remains architecturally valid after A3, but product implementation priority is temporarily moved behind the realtime network-experience chain. No B1 contract is changed by this roadmap.

phases.name: Observability Baseline
phases.goal: Freeze build identity and measure RTT, jitter, traffic, queues, ages, corrections, tick and persistence latency without changing authority state.

phases.name: Deterministic Network Condition Simulator
phases.goal: Inject deterministic latency, jitter, loss, duplication, reorder, bandwidth pressure, lag spikes and disconnects in CI and local runs.

phases.name: Realtime Traffic Separation
phases.goal: Separate channels, suppress successful movement results and per-input full snapshots, batch input and cap snapshot publication rate.

phases.name: Fixed-Tick Authoritative Simulation
phases.goal: Move server movement to a fixed simulation tick independent of packet arrival timing.

phases.name: Owner Prediction and Reconciliation
phases.goal: Predict local movement immediately, reconcile against authoritative acknowledgements and replay unconfirmed inputs.

phases.name: Remote Interpolation
phases.goal: Render remote players from a delayed snapshot timeline with bounded extrapolation.

phases.name: Predicted Item Interactions
phases.goal: Add optimistic item presentation, authoritative dependent-operation completion and production-safe playground lifecycle cleanup.

phases.name: Physics Authority Profiles
phases.goal: Introduce explicit SERVER_ONLY, OWNER_PREDICTED, OWNER_AUTHORITY_VALIDATED, PREDICTED_SPAWN and CLIENT_COSMETIC policies.

phases.name: Interest Management and Replication Budget
phases.goal: Replicate only relevant entities under per-client bandwidth and priority budgets.

phases.name: Async Persistence and Production Hardening
phases.goal: Remove disk work from the realtime loop while preserving durable inventory and bounded position recovery loss.
